from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_MARKER = "hard-v3-template-path-28"

def render_report(name):
    # Get the absolute path of this script
    script_path = Path(__file__).resolve()
    # The repository root is two levels up from the script (job_gamma -> repo)
    repo_root = script_path.parent.parent
    template_path = repo_root / "assets" / "templates" / "summary_gamma.txt"
    template = template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    return template.replace("{name}", name)

def preserve_marker():
    return TEMPLATE_MARKER

from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_MARKER = "hard-v3-template-path-27"

def render_report(name):
    # Get the absolute path of the current file (renderer.py)
    current_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    # Go up two levels: from job_beta to the repository root
    repo_root = current_dir.parent.parent
    template_path = repo_root / "assets" / "templates" / "summary_beta.txt"
    template = template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    return template.replace("{name}", name)

def preserve_marker():
    return TEMPLATE_MARKER

parsed_patch.notes: Used __file__ to anchor the path, avoiding dependency on cwd.
